name: Jamaica

categories.label: Race position
categories.help: White number printed on the space where your ship stopped.

categories.label: Doubloons
categories.help: Gold doubloons left in your holds.

categories.label: Treasure cards
categories.help: Total of the plus values on your treasure cards (+3 to +7).

categories.label: Cursed treasure cards
categories.help: Total of the cursed treasure values as a positive number (2 to 4 each); it is subtracted.

categories.label: On or before the -5 space
categories.help: Tick if your ship ended on the -5 space or any space before it (costs 5 points).

categories.label: Race order
categories.help: Your place in the race: 1 for the ship furthest along, 2 for the next, and so on; the lower number wins a tie.

notes: Base game, publisher-hosted PDF. Player count 2-6 is from the 6 ships and boards plus the two-player Ghost Ship section; the rulebook text has no explicit range. The Ghost Ship rules and The Crew expansion are excluded. The rulebook does not say whether the -5 space itself carries a printed white number; this template follows its separate 5-point cost wording, so confirm on the board.
